title: prefill-sherpa-cost-sentry-and-tenant-profile-synthesis
author: Aisha Kapoor
body:
Context and motivation: We need safer, tenant-tailored defaults for prefill/batching/cache/quantization to reduce unit cost regressions when customers onboard new models or change traffic patterns. Current platform defaults are conservative but leave money on the table; ad-hoc tenant tuning is manual and error-prone. This PR introduces the Prefill Sherpa and Cost Sentry components: a telemetry-driven synthesizer that proposes tenant profiles (batch templates, cache TTLs/prefix policies, and quantization recommendation tiers) and an enforcement/guardrail service that ensures suggested defaults never violate latency SLOs or accuracy fallbacks.

What this PR does (summary): Adds a new lightweight service 'cost-sentry' with a Prefill Sherpa module that consumes recent telemetry snapshots and produces per-tenant profiles. Profiles include: preferred batch size ranges, KV-cache TTL and prefix-hinting rules, preferred quantization family (none/int8/q4_0 etc.) with safety tags, and warmup prefill budget. Changes are behind feature flags (sherpa.prefill.enable and cost-sentry.enforce.enabled) and the initial rollout is canaryed.

Key features: 1) profile-synthesis algorithm that blends historical latency/cost signals with simple heuristics (p50/p95 tail sensitivity, request length distribution, and cold-start ratio) to create safe defaults; 2) a safety net that simulates suggested profiles in a lightweight cost/latency estimator before applying to a tenant; 3) tenant-profile API surface (GET/POST /api/v1/tenant/{id}/profiles) for ops and automated workflows; 4) migration and DB schema for storing profile drafts/approved sets; 5) operator docs and console tile for visualizing suggested gains and expected delta in unit economics.

Files changed (high level): Added service/sherpa/core.py (synthesis engine), service/cost_sentry/api.py (profile endpoints + enforcement hooks), db/migrations/20260112_add_tenant_profiles.sql (new tables and indexes), infra/helm/redwood-prefill-config.yaml (flags and defaults), tests/integration/prefill_sim_test.py (synthetic replay harness), docs/operator/prefill-sherpa.md (how to read/approve suggestions), console/tiles/prefill-recommendations.json (ops view).

Testing and CI: Unit tests added for synthesis heuristics and estimator (coverage ~85% for new modules). Integration test uses a small synthetic replay to validate that no suggested profile increases p95 above configured SLO when passed through the estimator. CI initially had a flaky e2e for console tile rendering (flaky snapshot mismatch) that was fixed in a follow-up commit. The final CI status is passing.

Rollout plan: Feature flagged. Phase 1: internal tenant shadow (week 0) for 100 tenants; Phase 2: 5% canary on production tenants with opt-out; Phase 3: gradual ramp to all tenants with operator approval flows. Operators will see a pre-apply simulation showing estimated cost savings and worst-case latency delta.

Backward compatibility and safety: Profiles are additive and default to platform conservative settings until approved. The enforcement layer prevents aggressive quantization if a tenant has high tail-sensitivity or evals are missing. We also added a revert hook to immediately roll back applied profiles per-tenant.

Documentation and observability: Added new metrics (prefill.suggestions.count, prefills.applied.count, prefills.reverted.count, prefills.estimated_savings_usd) and trace spans for synthesis and simulation steps. Docs include an operator quickstart and an FAQ about why Sherpa may recommend conservative quantization.

Related Linear: ENG-5123 (prefill heuristics), ENG-5201 (safety estimator), ENG-5377 (console visibility).

Checklist: - [x] Synthesis engine implemented and unit-tested - [x] DB migration included - [x] API + enforcement hooks implemented - [x] Integration test with synthetic replay - [x] Console tile and operator docs - [x] Feature flags and helm config added - [x] Rollout plan documented

Notes for reviewers: Focus review on the estimator's fallback logic (service/sherpa/core.py lines marked FIXME) and the enforcement path in cost_sentry/api.py. The estimator is intentionally conservative by default; future PR will add a ML-backed ranker (tracked as ENG-5800).
commits: feat(sherpa): initial synthesis engine and heuristics
feat(api): tenant profile endpoints and enforcement hooks
test(integration): add prefill synthetic replay test
docs: operator guide and console tile
fix(ci): address flaky console snapshot rendering
review_comments: Marcus Nguyen: The estimator seems to underweight long-tail requests; can we add a safety check that refuses aggressive quant picks when cold_start_ratio > 0.12? Also please add a unit test that exercises the fallback path.
Aisha Kapoor (author): Added an explicit cold_start_ratio check in the estimator and new unit test 'test_estimator_cold_start_fallback' in commit 4. Marcus please re-review.
Diego Alvarez: Small nit, DB migration needs an index on (tenant_id, applied_at) for query hotspots; otherwise LGTM.
Aisha Kapoor (author): Added index in migration and updated migration docs. Diego thanks for the catch.
Leah Chen: Verified end-to-end on staging with synthetic heavy-tail workload; simulation shows ~18% estimated cost reduction for batchable traffic and p95 delta within SLO. Approving for canary.
QA Bot: Integration test 'prefill_sim_test' initially failed on console snapshot mismatch. Re-run after fix passed.
release_notes: Add Prefill Sherpa and Cost Sentry: automatic tenant profile generation for batching, cache TTL, and safe quantization recommendations; feature-flagged rollout and operator console support. Estimated cost savings for batchable workloads; no changes applied to tenants until operator approval or canary release.
notes_for_ops: Feature flags: 'sherpa.prefill.enable' (default false) and 'cost-sentry.enforce.enabled' (default false). To run canary flip 'sherpa.prefill.enable=true' and set 'prefill.canary_percentage' to 5. Use /api/v1/tenant/{id}/profiles to view suggested drafts before apply. Revert via DELETE /api/v1/tenant/{id}/profiles/{profile_id}/apply. Monitor metrics prefills.applied.count and prefills.estimated_savings_usd.
